recentItems.title: Will Army target Ford Ranger to replace Land Rover?
recentItems.description:
The search is underway to find a replacement for the military's fleet of Land Rovers and Pinzgauers, with Ford aiming to secure the deal with the Ranger.

The US giant's military offerings for the Light Mobility Vehicle programme were on show at the British Army DVD 2026 event at Millbrook proving ground.

Jim Baumbick, the president of Ford Europe, highlighted the fact that the vehicle is already in widespread use around the world.

recentItems.title: VIP Bodyguards: Why close protection isn't for every military veteran
recentItems.description:
Training as a close protection officer teaches certain skills in fine detail, with many crossing over with Armed Forces expertise. 

But, while plenty in this line of work have a military past, not everyone with a military past makes it in this line of work. 

BFBS Forces News visited one training company going through the fundamentals with a group of budding bodyguards from around the world and asked how it all works.

recentItems.title: First female reservist passes gruelling P Company course
recentItems.description:
The first female reservist to pass the Army's gruelling P Company course has paid tribute to her best friend, an officer in the Household Cavalry who died last year.

Lance Corporal Grace Cussons, who passed the Reservist All Arms Pre-Parachute Selection on the anniversary of Captain Lizzie Godwin's death, said she was the person who inspired her to succeed.
